_comment: Minimal event pair for sigma_t1003_study cross-backend verification. SYNTHETIC events, labeled as such; no real telemetry. All four events share identical field values EXCEPT CallTrace, which varies only in path form. Fields chosen to isolate the selection_lowaccess_untrusted_path branch of proc_access_win_lsass_memdump v2/v3: TargetImage lsass.exe, GrantedAccess 0x1410 (exact-match low-access list), SourceImage outside filter_lowaccess_system_paths and not a Sysinternals binary, SourceUser not AUTHORI/AUTORI.

events.role: benign local path; MUST NOT alert on a correct rule; v2's bare-'\\' value makes it alert (the false positive mechanism)
same module content as E1 in UNC form; the intended target of the v2 bare-'\\' value; v3 drops it by design (documented trade-off)
same module content as E1 with no backslash at all; control that isolates the backslash as the trigger
same content in a user-writable path covered by an explicit pattern; MUST alert on both v2 and v3
